🚩
During the week, as a result of intensive offensive actions by units of the Tsentr Group of Forces,
the settlements of Annovka and Kucherov Yar, the Donetsk People's Republic, were liberated.
💥
Strikes were launched at formations
of three mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an assault brigade, an airmobile brigade, an airborne brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two marine brigades, and four national guard brigades.
▪️
The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 2,540 troops, 12 armoured fighting vehicles, 50 motor vehicles, eight field artillery guns, and eight electronic warfare and counter-fire stations.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continue to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
Last week, the settlements of Dolinka, Nezhenka, and Shevchenkovskoye in Zaporozhye region were liberated.
💥
The Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware
of a mechanised brigade, two assault brigades, two air assault brigades, three assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two marine brigades, and a territorial defence brigade.
▪️
The AFU losses in the area of responsibility of the Vostok Group of Forces amounted to more than 2,260 troops, 19 armoured fighting vehicles, and 37 motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Group hit manpower and military hardware of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade.
▪️
Over the past week, the enemy sustained losses of more than 260 troops, 118 motor vehicles, three uncrewed surface vehicles, and 16 electronic warfare and counter-fire stations.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
80 guided aerial bombs, 15 U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, 14 Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 5,989 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
221,637
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
670
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,739
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,775
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,295
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
70,417
units of support military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
❗️
From 22 to 28 August, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out
one massive and 12 group strikes
with high-precision weapons and attack drones, which hit enterprises of defence, metallurgical, and petroleum industries of Ukraine, logistics centres, fuel-power and transport infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, military airfields, workshops manufacturing unmanned aerial vehicles and components, ammunition, fuel and materiel depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
💥
In addition, the strikes
disabled infrastructure of the Ukrainian ports
, which were used to received and store military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants intended for use by the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
🔥
During the week,
a patrol boat
of the Ukrainian Navy, as well as eight vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, including
six dry cargo ships and two tankers
, were neutralised.
🚩
Last week,
units of the Sever Group of Forces established control over Pershe Travnya and Pisarevka (Sumy region).
💥
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of seven mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, five territorial defence brigades, and one National Guard brigade.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 1,550 troops, three tanks, 10 armoured fighting vehicles, 73 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, and five electronic warfare and counter-fire stations in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
During the week,
units of the Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They hit units of four mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,510 troops, 12 armoured fighting vehicles, including five Western-made vehicles, 136 motor vehicles, 16 field artillery guns, and 11 electronic warfare stations.
📍
Last week,
units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
They hit manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, an assault brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade.
▪️
Over the past week, in the area of responsibility of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, the enemy has lost more than 1,490 troops, 10 armoured fighting vehicles, 180 motor vehicles, and 19 field artillery guns.

item.title: ▫️ From under pressure to ultimate victory Mines below, drones above, underground moves
item.description: ▫️ From under pressure to ultimate victory 💬 Mines below, drones above, underground moves — an assaultman with the call sign 'Zokha' of the Vostok Group of Forces shared details of the battle for Shevchenkovskoye in Zaporozhye region. 'When assaulting one of the houses, about five AFU servicemen were detected there. After the battle, we began to mop up the building and found an underground way to the neighbouring street in about 30-50 metres. At this point, UAVs started attacking us. We managed to get out and continue the task,' said Zokha. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 Andrei Belousov presents Gold Star medals to our heroes National Centre for State Defence Control of the Russian Federation
item.description: Andrei Belousov presents Gold Star medals to our heroes 📍 National Centre for State Defence Control of the Russian Federation The Minister of Defence presented the Gold Star medals and personalised weapons to Russian servicemen, who were awarded the highest title of Russia, the Hero of the Russian Federation, for their courage and heroism in carrying out the tasks of the special military operation. ▫️ The Russian Defence Minister congratulated the servicemen on their well-deserved awards, thanked them for their impeccable service and loyalty to their military duty. 💬 Andrei Belousov noted that the servicemen, sparing no effort, performed the task, demonstrated the highest skill and showed exceptional courage and heroism, and the awards presented today are recognition of outstanding contribution to national sovereignty and security. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to deliver group strikes
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to deliver group strikes against Ukrainian defence industry enterprises, logistics centres as well as ports and vessels that used to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 As a result, the following targets were hit by strike unmanned aerial vehicles: 📍 In Kiev region: ▪️ an industrial enterprise in Velikaya Aleksandrovka (Ukrdefence Company LLC) producing the Lyut reconnaissance and unmanned ground vehicles and Khizhak remote-controlled ground modules; ▪️ a transport and logistics centre in Brovary (Raben Ukraine transport and logistics complex), used for the storage and distribution of components for UAVs of various types including fixed-wing drones. 📍 In Odessa region: ▪️ in the port of Izmail, a tanker unloading POLs delivered to Ukraine as well as two fuel storage tanks intended for the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▪️ in the port of Odessa, seven storage facilities containing military equipment intended to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ▪️ In addition, in the port of Odessa, an unmanned aerial vehicles workshop was hit. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 'It's better to move in the daytime. It's more dangerous at night' The storming soldier with the call sign 'Vysota'
item.description: 'It's better to move in the daytime. It's more dangerous at night' 💬 The storming soldier with the call sign 'Vysota' shared such an unusual detail of the assault. He took part in liberation of Nezhenka in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ It's all about a lot of mines and artificial obstacles, which the serviceman may not be able to see at night. ▫️ At the same time, it is impossible to stop in the open, and hostile drones are constantly spinning around in the sky. 'There was an open terrain of up to a kilometre. It was literally five to ten minutes to overcome them,' the storming soldier recalls. ▫️ Despite this, Russian troops did all they could and completed the task. Well done! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
